content.text: Submitted. The fallback-level exclusions paragraph (20.2) has been removed, leaving a clean preferred-only Section 20: Vendor defence and indemnity of Customer and its Affiliates across the four triggers, notice/control/cooperation procedure, a Customer indemnity confined to Customer-provided content and Customer's breach of Applicable Law, and the 20.5 remedies that keep Section 9.3's cross-reference intact. All official checks and the minimality gate pass.
